$comment: Baseline of today's UNPINNED readers of ephemeris_daily for check_node_series_pin.py (SS N-68/N-69, design section 7). FAIL-CLOSED: a read is pinned only when the lint can positively show it (see the script's docstring); everything it cannot classify is baselined here with a named owner and a reason, not modelled. It can only SHRINK: R1 new unpinned reader fails; R2 a count above what is found fails until lowered; R3 a retired reader may never return; R4 the total must equal RATCHET_CEILING_TOTAL; R5 owner+note required. Growth versus origin/main (any key, count, total or ceiling) fails in the governance pytest step unless this file carries a NEW top-level `ceiling_raise_approved: <reason>` (the test prints it). Matching is by (file, anchor, count): anchor = the enclosing def (class.def) / TS function, or the assigned constant name for a module-level constant; `lines_at_rollout` are human locators only. Never add an entry to make CI pass: pin the reader (NODE_SERIES_PREDICATE or a literal node_mode predicate in its WHERE) or add a `node-agnostic: <reason_code>: <text>` marker. Pravaha's gochara-family readers P1/P2/P5/P6/P7/P14/P15 are pinned and are NOT here.
